A [[human]] served as a '''box guard''' in an [[Unidentified Imperial factory facility|Imperial factory facility]] part of the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|Prison Complex]] on [[Narkina 5]].<ref name="Narkina" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the box guard stood on the left side of the catwalk in [[room five-two]] as a [[Ulaf's replacement|new prisoner]] was lowered into the room. [[Unit Five-Two-D]] then started an [[Narkina 5 prison escape|escape attempt]], during which the box guard was [[Death|killed]] by the [[prisoner]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor]].<ref name="Episode 10" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Box guard left was portrayed by [[Hubert Hanowicz]] in the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the eighth episode, "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]],"<ref name="Narkina" /> which aired on [[October 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}}</ref>
